reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Definition and representations constituting business opportunity
headings.reviewNote: Defines business opportunity as sale or lease over $500 for business startup with representations on location assistance, refunds, income guarantees, or risk-free profits.

headings.title: Inclusions within location finding assistance
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that assisting in finding locations includes providing locator company names, contracting for assistance, or collecting locator fees.

headings.title: Exclusions from business opportunity definition
headings.reviewNote: Excludes sales of up to five ongoing businesses by their owner and not-for-profit sales of demonstration equipment or training courses not exceeding $500.

headings.title: Inclusion of lessees and lessors
headings.reviewNote: Provides that purchaser includes a lessee and seller includes a lessor for purposes of business opportunity regulations.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 2000 enactment note; retained titles and refined subsection 3 note for the $500 ceiling on demonstration equipment and training courses.

headings.title: Prohibited representations and practices by sellers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits twelve enumerated seller practices, including misrepresentations, dual exclusive territory assignments, inferior equipment, and failure to provide a written contract.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor penalty for violations
headings.reviewNote: Makes any person who violates section 409.1003 guilty of a class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 2000 enactment note; edited both titles to reflect all twelve prohibited seller practices and the class A misdemeanor penalty for any section violation.

headings.title: One-year rescission right and return of products
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes contract rescission within one year for misleading statements, disclosure failures, or 45-day delivery defaults, barring unjust enrichment.

headings.title: Civil action for damages and attorney fees
headings.reviewNote: Permits injured purchasers to bring a civil action to recover damages, including reasonable attorney's fees, for statutory violations or contract breaches.

headings.title: Circuit court jurisdiction to grant injunctive relief
headings.reviewNote: Grants circuit courts jurisdiction upon complaint to enjoin further violations of business opportunity provisions.

headings.title: Remedies cumulative to other legal and equitable relief
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that statutory remedies are cumulative and in addition to any other remedies available at law or in equity.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and 2000 enactment note; retained titles and refined subsection 2 note to match statutory 'damages' wording without adding 'actual'.

headings.title: Filing and delivery of takeover bid registration statement
headings.reviewNote: Requires offeror to file registration statement with commissioner and deliver it to target company principal office upon commencement.

headings.title: Full and fair disclosure of material information to offerees
headings.reviewNote: Mandates full and fair disclosure to offerees of all material information contained in filed registration statement.

headings.title: Filing of solicitations and recommendations to offerees
headings.reviewNote: Bars solicitations or recommendations to accept or reject a takeover bid unless copies are filed with the commissioner when first published, sent, or given to offerees.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1986 enactment note; retained titles and refined subsection 3 note on filing timing when solicitations or recommendations are first published, sent, or given.

headings.title: Enumerated contents and disclosures of registration statement
headings.reviewNote: Specifies required disclosure items including prospectuses, offeror background, terms, financing sources, plans, shareholdings, contracts, state impacts, and labor records.

headings.title: Prompt amendment upon material changes in facts
headings.reviewNote: Requires prompt written or confirmed telephone notice to the commissioner and target company and prompt amendment of the registration statement upon material changes.

headings.title: Commissioner authority to permit omission of immaterial information
headings.reviewNote: Permits the commissioner to allow omission of required registration statement information found immaterial or unnecessary for protection of offerees.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections (including twelve registration items) and 1986 enactment note; retained titles and aligned subsection 2 and 3 notes with statutory notice and offeree-protection phrasing.

headings.title: Investigative powers, subpoenas, and sworn examinations
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commissioner to investigate compliance, require sworn statements, subpoena witnesses, and compel document production.

headings.title: Judicial injunctions against takeover bids and share purchases
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner to seek temporary or permanent court injunctions barring unlawful takeover bids or tendered share payments.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1986 enactment note; confirmed investigative powers, subpoena authority, and judicial injunction titles accurately reflect permissive 'may' authority.

headings.title: Criminal penalty for willful violations
headings.reviewNote: Classifies willful violations of takeover bid statutes as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Civil penalties for natural persons and corporations
headings.reviewNote: Imposes civil penalties of $1,000 for natural persons and $10,000 for corporations per violation, with each business day of specified filing defaults a separate violation.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1986 enactment note; retained titles and clarified in subsection 2 note that each business day of specified filing defaults is a separate violation.

headings.title: Administration and rulemaking authority of commissioner
headings.reviewNote: Charges commissioner of securities and designated staff with administering act and authorizes promulgation of administrative rules.

headings.title: Filing fees for takeover bid registration statements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner to establish registration filing fees up to $2,500 based on maximum consideration payable.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1986 enactment note; confirmed administration, rulemaking, and $2,500 maximum registration filing fee headings match archived text.

headings.title: Deemed appointment of secretary of state as process agent
headings.reviewNote: Deems nonresident offerors lacking in-state resident agents to have appointed secretary of state as agent for service of process.

headings.title: Service on secretary of state and mail notice
headings.reviewNote: Provides for service by leaving process at the secretary of state's office, effective only when notice and process are sent by certified or registered mail to last known address.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1986 enactment note; edited subsection 2 title to reflect certified or registered mail notice rather than certified mail alone.

headings.title: Prohibition against material misstatements and manipulative acts
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits making untrue statements, material omissions, or fraudulent practices in connection with any takeover bid or solicitation.

headings.title: Rulemaking defining fraudulent, deceptive, or manipulative acts
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the commissioner of securities to adopt, amend, and rescind rules prescribing fraudulent, deceptive, or manipulative acts or practices.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1986 enactment note; edited subsection 2 title to cover rulemaking defining fraudulent, deceptive, or manipulative acts or practices.

headings.title: Refusal of disbursements or transactions and notice requirements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes qualified individuals to refuse transactions reasonably believed exploitative, requiring notice within two business days to authorized parties, agencies, and adult.

headings.title: Expiration of transaction refusal
headings.reviewNote: Provides refusal expires upon reasonable belief exploitation will not occur or after ten business days from initial refusal.

headings.title: Extensions of transaction refusal by court or agency order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court, commissioner of securities, or health and senior services director orders extending refusal, subject to 30-day reviews.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 2015/2020 history note; confirmed permissive refusal authority, ten-business-day expiration, and court/agency extension headings with 30-day agency reviews.

headings.title: Prohibition on margin and leverage commodity transactions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits margin accounts, leverage contracts, or functionally equivalent arrangements for commodity delivery except as exempted.

headings.title: Prohibition on commodity contracts and options and exempt persons
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits commodity contract sales and options while exempting CFTC merchants, SEC broker-dealers, financial institutions, and registered commodity dealers.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed margin/leverage prohibition and commodity contract/option prohibition with seven exempt-person categories.

headings.title: Exempt transactions, physical precious metals, and cash commodities
headings.reviewNote: Exempts CFTC exclusive transactions, physical delivery of precious metals within seven days, commercial merchant cash contracts, and institutional buyers.

headings.title: Rulemaking, exemptive orders, and effective-date requirement
headings.reviewNote: Permits rules and exemptive orders for non-CFTC-exclusive transactions and requires chapter rules to comply with section 536.024 to become effective.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1985/1993/1995 history note; tightened subsection 2 title to cover rulemaking, exemptive orders, and the chapter-wide section 536.024 effective-date requirement.

headings.title: CFTC registration requirement for commodity merchants
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits engaging in business as a commodity merchant without valid CFTC registration, license, or statutory exemption.

headings.title: Designation requirement for commodity contract trading boards
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits boards of trade from trading commodity contracts or options without CFTC contract market designation.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed CFTC commodity merchant registration/exemption and contract market designation titles.

headings.title: Vicarious liability for acts of officials and agents
headings.reviewNote: Deems acts, omissions, or failures of officials and agents within employment scope to be the acts of the principal entity.

headings.title: Joint and several liability for controlling persons and affirmative defense
headings.reviewNote: Imposes joint and several liability on control persons, officers, and aiding employees absent proof of reasonable lack of knowledge.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed vicarious principal liability and joint-and-several controlling-person liability with reasonable-care defense.

headings.title: Investigative authority within and without the state
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner to conduct investigations within or outside Missouri to determine violations and aid enforcement.

headings.title: Publication of commodity violation information
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner to publish information concerning violations of commodity statutes, rules, or orders.

headings.title: Subpoena powers, oaths, and judicial enforcement proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commissioner to administer oaths, subpoena witnesses, compel records, and seek enforcement orders in Cole County or appropriate courts.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed investigative, publication, subpoena, and Cole County or out-of-state judicial enforcement headings.

headings.title: Administrative cease and desist orders and civil penalties
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner to issue cease and desist orders, take disciplinary action, or assess civil penalties up to $10,000 per violation.

headings.title: Judicial actions for injunctions, declarations, and receivers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner to initiate court actions for declaratory judgment, prohibitory/mandatory injunctions, and appointment of receivers.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed administrative cease-and-desist, disciplinary, and civil penalty powers and judicial action remedies.

headings.title: Circuit court civil penalties, restitution, and equitable remedies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court civil penalties up to $10,000, restitution, receivership, or injunctions for actual or threatened violations.

headings.title: Commissioner exempt from posting bond in official actions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits courts from requiring the commissioner to post a bond in any official action under sections 409.800 to 409.863.

headings.title: Remedies for out-of-state commodity law violations
headings.reviewNote: Permits circuit court legal, equitable, and ancillary receivership remedies for actual or threatened violations of another state's commodity or securities laws by nongovernmental persons.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1985 enactment note; edited subsection 2 title to cover bond exemption in any official action and subsection 3 title to cover out-of-state commodity law remedies.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for willful commodity violations
headings.reviewNote: Punishes willful commodity violations by fine up to $20,000, imprisonment up to ten years, or both.

headings.title: Referral of evidence for criminal prosecution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner to refer evidence to attorney general or prosecuting attorneys for initiation of criminal proceedings.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed willful violation criminal penalties ($20,000 / 10 years) and referral of evidence for prosecution.

headings.title: Administration and prohibition on misuse of nonpublic information
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits commissioner and staff from using nonpublic information for personal gain or trading prior to market assimilation.

headings.title: Public availability of records and confidential investigative files
headings.reviewNote: Designates records public under chapter 610 while exempting private investigations and federal non-disclosable materials, permitting sharing.

headings.title: Preservation of common law and statutory privileges
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that commodity provisions neither create nor derogate existing common law or statutory evidentiary privileges under subpoena.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed insider information restrictions, chapter 610 public/confidential record rules, and privilege preservation.

headings.title: Regulatory cooperation with state, federal, and international agencies
headings.reviewNote: Permits cooperation with other states, Canadian provinces, federal agencies, SROs, and law enforcement; source note flags original-rolls phrase 'this act' (apparently §§ 409.800 to 409.863).

headings.title: Permissible cooperative activities and subpoena enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates joint examinations, hearings, litigation, personnel sharing, document exchanges, and cross-jurisdictional subpoena enforcement.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and source notes; retained titles and documented original-rolls footnote flagging 'this act' in subsection 1 as apparently intending §§ 409.800 to 409.863.

headings.title: Irrevocable consent appointing commissioner process agent
headings.reviewNote: Requires registration applicants to file consent appointing commissioner agent for service in noncriminal proceedings, setting notice rules.

headings.title: Engaging in prohibited conduct as deemed appointment of commissioner
headings.reviewNote: Deems engaging in prohibited or actionable conduct as appointment of commissioner as attorney for process in noncriminal proceedings.

headings.title: Service procedure and affidavit of compliance
headings.reviewNote: Sets service delivery, registered mail to last address known to commissioner, and affidavit steps; archived text cites subsection 1 rather than subsection 2.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1985 enactment note; retained titles and noted subsection 3's archived cross-reference to subsection 1 while specifying last address known to the commissioner.

headings.title: Applicability to in-state sales, purchases, and offers
headings.reviewNote: Applies commodity provisions to persons buying, selling, or offering to buy or sell when offers originate or are accepted in-state.

headings.title: Rules determining when offers and acceptances are made in-state
headings.reviewNote: Establishes territorial rules for communications, exempting out-of-state publications and syndication broadcasts received in Missouri.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed both subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed in-state applicability for §§ 409.803, 409.808, and 409.810 and territorial rules for offers, acceptances, publications, and broadcasts.

headings.title: Commencement by notice of intent or summary order
headings.reviewNote: Requires commencing proceedings by written notice of intent or summary order, with thirty business days to request a hearing on a summary order.

headings.title: Commissioner authority to order hearing on own motion
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commissioner to set summary order proceedings for hearing on own motion without party request.

headings.title: Finality of summary orders absent hearing request
headings.reviewNote: Provides that un-challenged summary orders automatically become final after thirty business days.

headings.title: Hearing requirements, notice, and written findings
headings.reviewNote: Requires notice, hearing opportunity, and written findings of fact and conclusions of law before entering final orders.

headings.title: Public hearings and confidential hearing exception
headings.reviewNote: Requires administrative hearings to be public unless all respondents join in a request for a private hearing.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections and 1985 enactment note; retained titles and clarified in subsection 1 note that the summary-order hearing request window is thirty business days.

headings.title: Judicial review of final orders under contested case procedures
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes aggrieved persons to obtain judicial review of final orders pursuant to chapter 536 contested case procedures.

headings.title: Exclusive jurisdiction of reviewing court
headings.reviewNote: Grants reviewing court exclusive jurisdiction upon petition filing, except where additional evidence is ordered (archived text cites subsection 3 or 4).

headings.title: Petition for review does not operate as stay
headings.reviewNote: Provides that filing review petition does not stay commissioner's order absent specific court order.

headings.title: Leave to adduce additional evidence on good cause
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes court on good cause showing to order additional evidence taken before commissioner.

headings.title: Modification of findings and order upon new evidence
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner to modify findings and order based on additional evidence and file amended record with court.

headings.title: Standard of review and conclusiveness of supported findings
headings.reviewNote: Directs record review as amended (archived text cites subsections 3 and 4), making factual findings conclusive if supported by competent, material, and substantive evidence.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all six subsections and 1985 enactment note; retained titles and noted archived cross-references in subsections 2 and 6 to subsections 3 and 4.

headings.title: Application for licensing and consent to process
headings.reviewNote: Requires broker-dealers and sales representatives to file licensing applications with information required by rule and consent to process.

headings.title: Initial licensing fees for broker-dealers, branches, and representatives
headings.reviewNote: Establishes initial license fees: $100 for broker-dealers, $50 per branch office, and $25 for sales representatives.

headings.title: Annual renewal licensing fees
headings.reviewNote: Establishes annual fees: $75 for broker-dealers, $30 per branch office, and $15 for sales representatives.

headings.title: Definition of branch office
headings.reviewNote: Defines branch office as any non-principal in-state office where three or more sales representatives transact business.

headings.title: Retention of fees upon denial or termination
headings.reviewNote: Directs commissioner to retain fees upon application denial, withdrawal, revocation, cancellation, or license withdrawal.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all five subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed licensing applications, initial and annual fee schedules, branch office definition, and fee retention upon denial or termination.

headings.title: Commissioner authority to impose examination requirements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner by rule or order to require examinations for applicants or classes of applicants.

headings.title: Manner and administration of oral or written examinations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner or designee to administer oral or written examinations tailored by applicant class.

headings.title: Waiver of examination requirements
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commissioner by order to waive examinations when not necessary for investor protection.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed permissive examination authority, oral/written administration by class, and investor-protection waiver.

headings.title: Thirty-day effective date for licensing
headings.reviewNote: Provides licenses become effective thirty days after complete filing and exam satisfaction absent disciplinary proceedings, permitting earlier order.

headings.title: Annual expiration of licenses on December thirty-first
headings.reviewNote: Directs that licenses expire on December 31 of year issued unless commissioner prescribes another date by rule.

headings.title: Scope of sales representative license
headings.reviewNote: Restricts effectiveness of sales representative license to transactions on behalf of the sponsoring broker-dealer or issuer.

headings.title: Restriction on representing multiple broker-dealers or issuers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits representing multiple broker-dealers or issuers concurrently absent common control affiliation or commissioner authorization.

headings.title: Prompt notice of representative association or termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires representative and broker-dealer to promptly notify commissioner upon beginning or terminating association.

headings.title: Conditional and limited license classifications
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner by rule to establish classifications of licenses subject to activity limitations and conditions.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all six subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed 30-day effectiveness, December 31 expiration, representative scope, multiple-affiliation restrictions, notice, and conditional licenses.

headings.title: Annual report filing and fee requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensed broker-dealers and representatives to file annual reports with prescribed information and fee.

headings.title: Minimum net capital and debt ratios for broker-dealers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner by rule to prescribe minimum net capital and net capital-to-aggregate-indebtedness ratios.

headings.title: Notice of net capital deficiencies
headings.reviewNote: Requires broker-dealers to promptly notify commissioner if net capital or ratio requirements are not being met.

headings.title: Fidelity bond requirements
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commissioner by rule to require furnishing of fidelity bonds from commodity broker-dealers.

headings.title: Required financial and other reports
headings.reviewNote: Requires licensed commodity broker-dealers to file financial and other reports determined necessary or appropriate by commissioner rule.

headings.title: Recordkeeping and five-year preservation requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires making and preserving records for five years in accessible data storage formats subject to commissioner rule.

headings.title: Prompt filing of correcting amendments
headings.reviewNote: Mandates prompt filing of correcting amendments whenever filed information becomes materially inaccurate or incomplete.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all seven subsections and 1985 enactment note; edited subsection 5 title to 'Required financial and other reports' to avoid unstated 'periodic' and 'operational' qualifiers.

headings.title: Unannounced records examinations within and without the state
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner to examine required records without prior notice within or outside Missouri in readable form.

headings.title: Copying of records by commissioner or licensee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner to copy records or require licensee to provide copies in a reasonable manner.

headings.title: Assessment of reasonable examination fees
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commissioner to impose reasonable fees for conducting examinations under this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all three subsections and 1985 enactment note; confirmed unannounced records examinations, copying authority, and reasonable examination fee assessment.

headings.title: Statutory grounds for license discipline, suspension, or revocation
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates twelve grounds for public-interest license discipline; source note flags 'demonstrating' in (5) absent from original rolls, and (10) cites subsection 3.

headings.title: Ninety-day limitation for disclosed facts
headings.reviewNote: Bars suspension or revocation based on facts disclosed in application unless proceedings are instituted within ninety days of issuance.

headings.title: Summary suspension, postponement, and fifteen-day hearing
headings.reviewNote: Permits summary license suspension or postponement of effective date in the public interest, with prompt notice and hearing set within fifteen days of written request.

headings.title: Cancellation of inactive, incapacitated, or missing licenses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commissioner by order to cancel applications or licenses of persons ceased business, incompetent, or unlocatable.

entries.reviewSummary: Reviewed all four subsections and source notes; edited subsection 3 title to include license postponement and documented original-rolls footnote on 'demonstrating' in subsection 1(5) and subsection 1(10)'s reference to subsection 3.
